text: The scheme employs a parametric 'flood day' trigger, initiating payouts after 11 continuous flood days. It uses a model-first design to price premiums and determine payouts in a data-scarce environment. The initiative emphasizes rapid disbursement through planned mobile payments and is backed by Swiss Re's reinsurance, ensuring risk transfer capacity beyond local markets.

metadata.solution_name: JRSM‑1 Flood Protection Parametric Insurance Scheme
